item.title: New report shows the economic toll of ICE raids
item.description: A new study shows the steep economic cost of 2025's ICE raids in Chicago. Fear kept many immigrants home, draining the area of more than $1.26 billion in lost retail, restaurant, and sales-tax revenue.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Many Americans have no memory of 9/11. A foundation hopes an artifact can change that
